home.title: Hockey Tools | Stick & Skate Guides
home.description: Practical hockey stick, skate sharpening and equipment guides for players, parents and coaches.

flex.description: Estimate a starting hockey stick flex from player weight, height, age and playing style. Compare nearby options before choosing a stick.

sharpening.description: Understand hockey skate hollow radius in mm, compare 5/8" (15.9 mm) and 1/2" (12.7 mm) for grip and glide, and use a calculator to find a starting point.

profiling.description: A sourced guide to hockey skate profiling: Quad Zero, Quad, Zuperior, Ellipse and single-radius geometry, history, biomechanics, comparisons and FAQ.
